verdict.rationale: Lago's core billing engine inherently runs recurring cycles (monthly/yearly subscription billing) and the Dunning Agent appears to run periodic checks over invoices/payments, which is a recurring automated workflow, but there is no documented feature letting an AI-native user define or schedule arbitrary recurring jobs/workflows via API or agent. missing for 10: explicit job/workflow scheduler, cron-like API, user-configurable recurrence for AI agent tasks beyond built-in billing cycles.
